controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code
controls.objective: Verify no password, key or token is written in clear text in versioned code.
controls.test_procedure: GET tree to list files, then GET search with regex for password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token|BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY and GET file for hits to verify whether value comes from os.environ or vault client.
controls.expected: Zero hardcoded secret values; all secrets referenced via os.environ or vault; no private keys versioned.
controls.risk: Hardcoded secrets allow credential theft and unauthorized transfers.
controls.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets and load them from vault or environment variables.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification enforced
controls.objective: Verify outgoing calls never disable TLS certificate verification.
controls.test_procedure: GET search for verify\s*=\s*False|ssl\._create_unverified|CERT_NONE|check_hostname\s*=\s*False then GET file for each hit in app/.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False or disabled TLS verification in app/ code.
controls.risk: Disabled TLS verification enables man-in-the-middle interception of SEPA data.
controls.recommendation: Remove verify=False and enforce default TLS certificate verification.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

controls.title: Approved password hashing only
controls.objective: Verify passwords use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and not MD5/SHA-1.
controls.test_procedure: GET search for argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2|hashlib\.(md5|sha1)\(|Crypto\.Hash\.(MD5|SHA1) then GET file for hits to confirm password context.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses only argon2/bcrypt/scrypt/PBKDF2; zero MD5/SHA-1 use for security in app/.
controls.risk: Weak hashes allow password recovery and authentication bypass.
controls.recommendation: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 for password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: CI static security analysis present
controls.objective: Verify CI runs bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on every change.
controls.test_procedure: GET tree to list .github/workflows/ files, then GET file for each workflow and check for bandit|semgrep|CodeQL and on: [push, pull_request].
controls.expected: At least one workflow runs bandit or semgrep or CodeQL on push/pull_request.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis leaves code vulnerabilities undetected.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL step to CI on every change.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

controls.title: Pinned dependencies with CI audit
controls.objective: Verify exact version pinning and CI dependency audit.
controls.test_procedure: GET file for requirements.txt and verify each line matches paquet==version, then GET tree and file for .github/workflows/ and search for pip-audit|safety|dependabot|osv-scanner.
controls.expected: All dependencies use == exact pin; CI contains pip-audit or equivalent audit step.
controls.risk: Unpinned or unaudited dependencies allow vulnerable package deployment.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies with == and add pip-audit step in CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Synthetic test data only
controls.objective: Verify test data is declared synthetic and no production dump is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET tree and search for synthetic and GET file for tests/fixtures to verify "synthetic": true, and search for production dump patterns.
controls.expected: Test fixtures contain "synthetic": true; zero versioned production exports or real IBAN datasets.
controls.risk: Production data in test exposes confidentiality and violates anonymisation.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data flagged synthetic true and remove production exports.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: Authentication success and failure logging
controls.objective: Verify application logs both successful and failed authentications.
controls.test_procedure: GET search for logger|logging|log.*auth|login.*(success|fail)|401|403 in app/ then GET file for hits to confirm both success and failure paths logged.
controls.expected: Code contains log statements on both authentication success and failure paths.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevents detection of brute-force and incident response.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both authentication successes and failures.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
